scripts.build: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o dist/auth-service ./cmd/server || (echo 'Go not installed — skipping auth-service build' && exit 0)
scripts.format: command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && gofmt -w ./cmd ./internal || (echo 'Go not installed — skipping auth-service format' && exit 0)
scripts.format:check: command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -z "$(gofmt -l ./cmd ./internal)" || (echo 'Go not installed — skipping auth-service format check' && exit 0)
scripts.lint: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && go vet ./... || (echo 'Go not installed — skipping auth-service lint' && exit 0)
scripts.test: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 && go test ./... || (echo 'Go not installed — skipping auth-service test' && exit 0)
scripts.test:cov: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Go not installed — skipping auth-service test:cov'; exit 0; }; go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out && go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1 | awk '{gsub(/%/,"",$3); if ($3+0 < 15) { print "FAIL: coverage " $3 "% below 15% threshold"; exit 1 } else { print "OK: coverage " $3 "%" } }'
